department: Faculty of Science — Department of Statistics and Data Science

deadline.value: Semester 1 (August) intake deadline is November 15 of the previous year (Semester 2 January intake deadline is May 15 of the previous year).
deadline.quote: Semester 1 (August) | 15 November of the previous year

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists specifically for statistics/data science (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The PhD in Statistics and Data Science prospective students page does not state whether pre-admission supervisor confirmation is required.

funding.value: Priority for the NUS Research Scholarship (including full tuition fee subsidy and monthly stipend, plus departmental top-ups) is given to PhD applicants.
funding.quote: Priority for NUS Research Scholarship will be given to PhD applicants. | The scholarship includes a full tuition fee subsidy, which is in the form of credit towards student’s fee bill when the fee is due. | In addition, our department provides additional top-ups to the scholars.

entry_route.value: Requires a good GPA in a relevant bachelor's or master's degree (upper second class Honours or higher in Mathematics/Statistics or equivalent).
entry_route.quote: A good GPA in a relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree. (Applicants should have an upper second class Honours degree or higher in Mathematics /Statistics or equivalent qualifications and the ability to pursue research in Statistics/Probability.)

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional, though strong GRE scores (minimum 320 V+Q and 3.5 AW guideline) significantly strengthen the application.
gre_general.quote: Standardized test scores such as the GRE. | Items (5) to (7) are optional; however, do note that evidence of strong quantitative, verbal, and analytical skills through GRE scores, as well as indicators of research skills and experience will significantly strengthen your application.

notes: Covers PhD in Statistics and Data Science (covers both statistics and data science).
